title: Wack 100 Reacts To Alleged Altercation Between Chris Brown & Usher [Listen]
htmlContent:
Chris Brown's 34th birthday party had started out as a celebration, with the singer surrounded by friends and family at the Skate Rock City roller rink in Las Vegas. However, things took a turn for the worse when Brown was allegedly seen arguing with longtime friend and mentor Usher.

According to reports, Brown had been trying to talk to Teyana Taylor, but she was ignoring him. This allegedly led to Brown becoming upset and yelling at Taylor, with Usher stepping in to try and calm the situation down.

However, Brown was reportedly not in the mood to listen and began cursing at both Taylor and Usher before storming out of the skating rink with his crew. Usher, determined to make amends with his friend, took off his skates and headed outside to find Brown.

Eyewitnesses claim to have seen Usher emerge from behind a string of charter buses in the parking lot with what appeared to be a bloody nose. It's unclear what exactly happened between the two singers, but rumors of a physical altercation have been swirling since the incident.

Despite the alleged altercation, both Brown and Usher are scheduled to perform at the Lovers and Friends festival later that night. Fans of both singers are eagerly anticipating their performances, but some are wondering if the reported incident will have any impact on their shows.

For now, both Brown and Usher have remained tight-lipped about the incident. However, the incident has certainly put a damper on what was supposed to be a joyous celebration for Brown's birthday. Fans will have to wait and see what happens next and if there will be any fallout from the reported altercation between the two friends.

After news broke word got back to Wack 100, who was on Clubhouse in the 100 ENT room and according to Wack 100, "It sounded like Chris Brown was high again he just hasn't ran into the right one. Well, he did before they stripped him once already, said Wack.

"It looks like Usher was defending Teyana Taylor. They Chris Brown went off on her cussing her out calling her all types of s***. Usher was hosting a party for Chris and I guess while he was trying to get in the middle of it, they took off on him."
